        return (arr - mn) / (mx - mn)

    clust_n = normalize(clustering) + epsilon
    core_n = normalize(core_number) + epsilon

        if not dists:

            continue
        avg_dist = sum(dists) / len(dists)
        closeness_vals.append(1.0 / (avg_dist + epsilon))

    def ranks(arr, reverse=True):
        order = arr.argsort()
        if reverse:
            order = order[::-1]
        ranks_arr = np.empty_like(order, dtype=int)
        ranks_arr[order] = np.arange(1, len(arr)+1)
        return ranks_arr

    ev_rank = ranks(ev, True)
    clust_rank = ranks(clust, False)  # low clustering is better (inverse)

    def pct(rank_arr):
        return 1.0 - (rank_arr - 1) / (n - 1 + epsilon)  # top rank -> 1, lowest -> 0

    deg_pct = pct(deg_rank)
    betw_pct = pct(betw_rank)
    core_pct = pct(core_rank)
